train.task: Move across to the right room.
Go all the way to the far corner.
Could you head over to the west-side room?
Stop at the entrance between the two rooms.
Proceed to the most distant corner on the right.
Visit the left room, then finish at the doorway.
Start at the beginning and travel to the right room.
Go through the entrance and stop in the room on the east side.
First visit the west room, then return to the starting point.
Travel to the right-hand room and continue to its farthest corner.

eval.task: Position yourself at the building's southwest point of origin.
I need you beside the passage connecting the two enclosed spaces.
Head for the chamber occupying the western half of the building.
Settle in the compartment beyond the dividing wall, on its eastern side.
Reach the most remote endpoint of the eastern area.
Go to the spot where someone first enters the mapped building.
Please wait at the narrow opening that allows movement between the two interior spaces.
Take me to the western enclosed area, the one on the left when facing east.
Move into the accommodation on the opposite side of the central partition from the western chamber.
I want the endpoint furthest from the southwest origin, within the eastern section.
Start at the southwest origin, pass through the inter-room opening, and finish in the eastern enclosure.
Visit the western chamber first, then stop at the narrow connection in the partition.
From the initial position, travel to the eastern compartment and continue to its outermost extremity.
Proceed to the western side, return to the point of departure, and remain there.
Cross the internal threshold into the eastern space, then head back and finish in the western enclosure.
Go past the connecting aperture, but do not stop there. Finish inside the room on the east.
Pass through the western chamber and the central opening. Your destination is the farthest extremity of the eastern side.
The western space is not where I want you. Go to the place where the journey begins instead.
Travel toward the eastern enclosure, but halt at the boundary passage separating the two rooms.
Ignore the starting area. I need you in the chamber immediately west of the internal passage.
Go to the farthest extremity on the right, then come back and finish in the eastern room itself.
Take the route through the western enclosure and the connecting gap, ending at the distant endpoint beyond them.
First head to the eastern compartment, then visit the southwest departure point, and finally stop in the western compartment.
Move to the central connection, continue into the eastern space, and then return to the original departure location.
Take me to the western room. Actually, forget that; I want the remote extremity on the opposite side.
Head for the central passage. No, change of plan: finish in the enclosed space to its west.
I initially wanted the eastern chamber, but on second thought, stop at the building's original entry position.
Go to the distant endpoint, wait—make that the narrow connection between the two interior areas.
Please proceed to the southwest departure point, then to the western enclosure. Correction: your final destination is the eastern enclosure.
Visit the connecting aperture, then the eastern chamber. Actually, continue beyond that room to its farthest extremity.
